text:
Ivy Z: Running the quickstart (curl) as a new workspace. First request returned text, then immediate 402 billing_required on next call. Anyone seen flip-flop behavior?
Marco G: Which key? Workspace key or sandbox key?
Ivy Z: Workspace key from the console (ws_ivyz_team). Used the curl example exactly.
Ivy Z: Curl reply:
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
{... streaming tokens ...}
# next call
HTTP/1.1 402 Payment Required
{"error":"billing.required","message":"Enable billing to use API"}
```
SDK-bot: SDKs do not retry 402. First success then fail usually means activation is async or a transient sandbox route served one request.
billing-bot: Billing check ws_ivyz_team: api_access=false, trial_credits=0, payment_method=unset, last_action=1766009000.
ops-bot: Found async task 91234 enabling API for ws_ivyz_team: status=failed, reason=rate-limit to payments provider.
Marco G: UI likely showed optimistic success. Quick unblock: manual flip on billing console or requeue job. We'll flip to unblock.
Ivy Z: Please flip, demo in 20m.
Marco G: Done. api_access=true for ws_ivyz_team. Requeued job with backoff.
billing-bot: Confirmed api_access=true.
Ivy Z: Re-ran curl, now 200 consistently. First successful call for real.
Ivy Z: Docs suggestion: quickstart should include a step to verify "API access: enabled" and show the exact error body so new devs don't mistake a single successful call. Also add healthcheck script that fails on 4xx.
Marco G: Filing a devex ticket to add the verification step and add a note to the SDK error message to include workspace id when available.
Ivy Z: Thanks all :tada:
